title: Ahom Vocabulary and Naming System (আহোম নামাকৰণ আৰু শব্দকোষ)
author: Nang Dharitri Gogoi Phukan (নাং ধৰিত্ৰী গগৈ ফুকন)
category: Ban Ok Pup Lik Mioung Tai / Indigenous Cultural Heritage
provenance: Dhemaji & Gauhati: Ban Ok Pup Lik Mioung Tai / Internet Archive (ahom-vocabulary-and-naming-system)
license: Open Access / Community Educational Heritage (Mark 1.0 / CC0)
description: Comprehensive reference work on traditional Tai-Ahom naming conventions, clan onomastics, and cultural vocabulary compiled by Nang Dharitri Gogoi Phukan. Documents the ritual prayer invocations (Ai Sing Lao, Chao Kao E), gender-differentiated personal names (Ai, Chao, Nang), ancestral clan titles, and traditional formulas for birth rites, coronation, and ancestor veneration shared across Southwestern Tai groups in Assam.
